_about: Official EUROAVIA Ideathon 2026 Ansys bracket set-up, written 2026-11-05 from the organisers' card (Ideathon_Challenge_Ansys_2026.docx) and CAD (Eurovia Challenge 2026 CAD file.dsco, geometry measured in derived/features.json). Interpretation choices are marked [Y] in setup/boundary_conditions.md. Hole ids follow aerokit.bracket.features ordering (axis, then centre); check them against the first bracket_day.py hole scan before use. | v2 (5 Nov 13:10): non-design regions per industrial TO practice — base skin kept (one continuous mounting flange ties both lugs and all 4 bolts), lug eyes kept to the ORIGINAL edge distance (e = 61.4 mm above the pin), bolt bosses Ø105 through the plate; see setup/TO_v2_method.md | v3 skeleton: base skin NOT frozen; symmetry x/y; FoS on yield; one-body gate | v4: X-braced bolt pattern (auto rule), LC4 racking [Y], symmetry auto, FoS on yield
name: EUROAVIA 2026 cowling-support bracket (initial S275N design)

load_cases.name: LC1a Fz+97 kN, Fy+24 kN each pin
LC1b Fz+97 kN, Fy-24 kN each pin
LC1c Fz+97 kN, Fy +24/-24 kN (opposite, sensitivity)
LC2 My 2000 N m (1000 per pin bore)
LC4 racking (pin alignment) Fx +24/-24 kN [Y]
load_cases._about: not in the card: opposite in-plane forces on the two lugs (pin alignment / racking robustness), magnitude = the card's lateral 24 kN [Y]

non_design._about: v4 (5 Nov 14:20): frozen = functional interfaces only (bolt bosses r 52.5 over z 30-100, lug eyes r 61.4) + automatic X bracing of the bolt pattern (features.support_ties, round bars R 7.8 mm at z 65 joining diagonal bolts). The lug-to-lug rod of v3 is removed. Everything else is design space.

design_criteria._about: card: FoS 1.5 on yield at working temperature (>300 C) [Y: applied as vM_max*1.5 <= Fty(300 C)]; max displacement < 1/400 of largest dimension (661.01 mm -> 1.653 mm) | 5 Nov ~13:45 mentor: FoS 1.5 preferably on YIELD -> strength_basis 'yield' (U = 1.5 sigma / Fty(T))

_symmetry_about: auto: features.detect_symmetry finds the mirror planes from the holes, supports and load set (x 500, y 200.09 for the official set-up; identical voxel groups to the 14:03 run with x 500 / y 200.28)
